user_saw: Users who requested omitted thinking could still receive an Anthropic thinking summary.
summary: The fix moves rolling Anthropic defaults to Opus 5.5, preserves configured aliases during Claude CLI setup, and forwards thinkingDisplay through both Anthropic request paths.
reasoning: I checked the Opus 5.5 foundation diff, whose commit message explicitly says it preserves the Opus 5 defaults and aliases. Both request paths already dropped thinkingDisplay in the July 1 snapshot, and a later transport move carried the omission forward. The available history stops before I could verify when the omission was introduced or whether either affected path had previously honored the setting.
